

```{r}
library(sf)          # vector handling

library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}
average_sst_2008 <- rast('EDS223-HW3/data/data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
average_sst_2009 <- rast('EDS223-HW3/data/data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
average_sst_2010 <- rast('EDS223-HW3/data/data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
average_sst_2011 <- rast('EDS223-HW3/data/data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
average_sst_2012 <- rast('EDS223-HW3/data/data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')
depth <- rast('EDS223-HW3/data/data/depth.tif')
regions <- st_read('EDS223-HW3/data/data/wc_regions_clean.shp')
```

```{r}
same.crs(average_sst_2008, depth)
same.crs(depth, regions)
```

```{r}
average_sst_stack <- c(average_sst_2008, average_sst_2009, average_sst_2010, average_sst_2011, average_sst_2012)
average_sst_stack
```

```{r}
mean_sst <- mean(average_sst_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
average_sst_c <- mean_sst - 273.15
plot(average_sst_c)
```
